There’s no denying that Aston Martin is one of the best premium British automotive brands. But despite their pedigree and history, Mat has never been that much of a fan of them! 

However, he’s got his hands on an all-new Vanquish, and he’s about to see if this car has what it takes to change his mind! So let’s take a closer look at this luxurious grand tourer… 

When it comes to the design, the Vanquish is an absolute behemoth on the road, measuring almost 5 metres long! Up front, there is the traditional Aston Martin grille, though in this instance it’s larger than usual to allow maximum airflow to the huge V12 under the bonnet. The bonnet also features two carbon-fibre strakes that give it even more presence on the road.
